description.value:
You gain one of the following features: Devastating Critical if you chose Juyo, or Their Power, My Strength if you chose Vaapad.

Devastating Critical. Whenever you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you add a bonus to that weapon's damage roll equal to your guardian level.

Their Power, My Strength. Whenever a force power deals damage to you, you may reduce that damage by an amount equal to your guardian level, with no action required.

You have five uses of this feature, gaining one more at 17th level, and you regain all uses on finishing a short or long rest.
